description: This Java source file defines the class `SerialPortList` which provides methods to list available serial port names on various operating systems. It includes platform-specific patterns for identifying serial devices, handles sorting port names with a custom comparator, and interfaces with native code through the `SerialNativeInterface` class to access system ports.
